# Flame v2.6.2

- Fix bundled Nerd Fonts being unavailable to the browser by serving public clock assets, while preserving optional personal LCD fonts in the persistent data volume.
- Revalidate the HTML entry point, clock font CSS and font assets; keep fingerprinted JavaScript and CSS bundles cacheable and API responses uncached.
- Show an explicit empty state for Applications and provide retry feedback when the applications API fails.
- Extend Playwright coverage for font loading, missing font responses, cache headers, and the empty Applications page.
